_adminsComment: Usernames with access to /admin — the traveller list, the server statistics and the server log (§14.6). Read per request, so removing a name takes effect immediately rather than when their token expires. Case-insensitive. An empty list means nobody.

FileLog._comment: The log the /admin/logs screen reads. Off by default: a deployment that mounts no volume for these would fill its own container layer. RetainDays is swept by the nightly maintenance job, which honours Maintenance:DryRun.

ConnectionStrings._comment: Placeholder only. The real value lives in User Secrets locally and in the environment in production (§14.3).

About._comment: A fork running a modified server owes its users its own source, not ours. Point this at the repository this build actually came from.
